content: Arjun Reddy expressed shock and concern that his health insurance policy expired on March 10th without prior notification. The insurance agent, Ravi Menon, apologized for the oversight and provided the invoice and reinstatement form via email. Arjun confirmed receipt of the documents, agreed to review them, and stated he would complete the form and pay the premium ASAP. Ravi also agreed to investigate why the expiration reminders were not sent.

action_items: Investigate why reminders were not sent
Complete the reinstatement form and pay the premium ASAP
